reporting: Mean plus/minus sample standard deviation across three RUN-level scores; ddof=1. Never SD over AI raters, categories, folds or images.
aggregation: Coherence: combine equal-size 75-group folds within each run, shared Vanilla once. Concentration/AP: preserve equal-category macro averaging within each run after fold aggregation; 73/75 presence-supported targets, 75/75 AP targets.
units: All means/SDs below are unit-interval rates; multiply BOTH by100 for percentage-point presentation.
limits: Shared initialization and image pools; descriptive training-order SD, not model-population uncertainty or a significance test.
Coherence reviewers are AI contexts, not independent humans. Pair semantic/visual and whole endpoints remain separate.
Category split excludes annotations from featurizer guidance; excluded objects may be present in training images. Readout calibration may use their labels after fitting.
Category-split whole/pair coherence scores every native group, not only withheld-category readouts.
Concentration is around75 predefined targets; it does not establish consolidation of every discovered concept.
Human validation, independent visual target alignment and genuinely new-image tests remain outstanding.
